failure.detail: The production referee adapter creates a receipt for the unregistered PrConvergenceGate model, but FsTlcToolchain validates that receipt through loadVerifiedTlaSources and rejects it because model-map.json cannot contain the model until proof succeeds. Every baseline, falling, and vacuity run therefore fails with PreparationError/MODEL_RECEIPT: verified model is unavailable: PrConvergenceGate.

reason: The author-new route requires proof before registration, while the real proof toolchain requires registration before accepting the model receipt. No transient referee-only verification path exists.
